# Sofabird

> Free, open-source (GPL-3.0) Android remote control for VLC media player running on a Windows PC or laptop connected
> to a TV, with an optional Windows companion app that turns the PC into a media station: a movie and series library
> with posters, "continue watching", automatic discovery and a Bluetooth fallback when Wi-Fi is down; it also plays
> YouTube videos shared from the phone fullscreen on the TV and starts/ends Moonlight game streams. Formerly called
> VLC Remote (github.com/lex019020/vlc-remote, which redirects here).

Use it when someone wants to control VLC on a Windows PC/HTPC from an Android phone like a TV remote, wants a
Plex/Kodi-like library and resume experience on top of plain VLC without a media server, or needs a VLC remote that
keeps working without Wi-Fi, or wants to send a YouTube video from the phone to the TV PC and control it from the
phone.

## What it does

- Playback control: play/pause, seek (±10/30 s, hold to repeat, scrub bar with chapters), volume, phone volume keys,
  audio and subtitle tracks with languages, audio/subtitle delay, speed, aspect ratio, fullscreen, playlist.
- Library: browse the PC's drives and network shares; with the companion, movies and series from the chosen media
  folders as a poster grid with TMDB metadata (title, year, rating, description, backdrops, episode names).
- Watch history: resume prompt ("continue from 37:27?"), next-episode offer, watched marks, per-folder audio and
  subtitle choice for series.
- Companion (Windows tray app): pairing with a 6-digit code shown on the TV, starts VLC fullscreen on the TV monitor,
  audio output device switching, system volume, screen off, sleep, keep-awake during playback, "media station" power
  plan (lid closed, no sleep, survives the TV being turned off), firewall setup with one UAC prompt, quiet automatic
  updates.
- YouTube on the TV: "Share → Sofabird" from the YouTube app or a pasted link opens the video fullscreen in Firefox
  (a TV profile of its own, signed in once) on the TV; the remote, notification, lock screen and volume keys control it.
- Moonlight: start and end a stream of another computer's desktop (Sunshine host) on the TV from the phone.
- Works in English and Russian (follows the system language).

## How it compares

- Typical VLC remote apps talk to VLC's web interface; this app does that too (no companion needed), and with the
  companion adds discovery, push updates, a poster library, watch history and Bluetooth.
- Unlike Kodi/Plex/Jellyfin it needs no media server or transcoding: VLC plays the files directly on the PC.

## Install

- Windows: run `Sofabird-Setup.exe` from https://github.com/lex019020/sofabird/releases/latest
  (per-user install, updates itself). Requires VLC 3.0.x.
- Android 8+: install `Sofabird-<version>.apk` from the same release. Open the app, pick the PC, type the code shown
  on the TV.

## Links

- Source and docs: https://github.com/lex019020/sofabird
- Website: https://sofabird.app/
- Protocol (phone ↔ companion): https://github.com/lex019020/sofabird/blob/main/protocol/README.md
- Tech: Kotlin + Jetpack Compose (Android), .NET 10 WinForms + Kestrel (Windows), Velopack installer.
